messages.subject: Shin send a resize event(changing number of cols in a grid layout)
parts:
Hello,

I posted this on Stackoverflow but this site probably the right one.

I have a UI element like


fluidRow(column(12, rbokehOutput("linePlots")) )


the server.R returns



output$linePlots <- renderRbokeh({
         ....
         grid_plot(p1,ncol=3,byrow=TRUE, same_axes=FALSE,width=1500)

}



Which is a rbokeh figure(from the package rbokeh).


When the window resizes i would like to return an alternative grid_plot with a different value for ncol (that i will compute based on the size of the containing div)


Is this possible in Shiny?


Thanks in advance
Saptarshi
